title: Parameter-Efficient Temporal Domain Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2602.11965v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Temporal domain generalization (TDG) learns from a sequence of observed domains to predict models for unseen future domains. Existing parameter-dynamics methods become prohibitively expensive at modern backbone scales because their temporal encoders and generators operate on the entire adapted parameter state. Replacing full-model updates with LoRA does not remove this failure mode: the dynamics model must still encode and reconstruct every adapter parameter, making the auxiliary model itself prohibitively large for modern backbones. We propose Low-rank Time-varying Core (LoTiC), a parameter-efficient TDG method that decomposes temporal updates into shared low-rank bases and a compact core. The bases define a stable update subspace, while only the core evolves. LoTiC therefore learns temporal dynamics in an r*r space instead of tracking the full adapter. translated_title: 参数高效的时序域泛化
translated_abstract: 时序域泛化从一系列已观测的域中学习，以预测未见未来域的模型。现有的参数动力学方法在现代主干网络规模下变得极其昂贵，因为其时序编码器和生成器需要对整个适配后的参数状态进行操作。用LoRA替换全模型更新并不能消除这一失效模式：动力学模型仍然必须编码并重构每一个适配器参数，使得辅助模型本身对于现代主干网络而言规模过于庞大。我们提出了低秩时变核心方法，这是一种参数高效的TDG方法，它将时序更新分解为共享的低秩基和一个紧凑的核心。低秩基定义了一个稳定的更新子空间，而只有核心会随时间演化。因此，LoTiC在一个r×r的空间中学习时序动力学，而不必追踪完整的适配器。我们通过参数增量的几何结构来论证这种分解的合理性。
tldr: LoTiC通过将时序参数更新分解为共享的低秩基和一个紧凑的时变核心，在r×r的小空间中学习时序动力学，从而实现对现代大模型参数高效的时序域泛化。
en_tdlr: LoTiC enables parameter-efficient temporal domain generalization by decomposing temporal parameter updates into shared low-rank bases and a compact time-varying core, learning dynamics in a small r×r space instead of tracking the full adapter.
